title: GoGoGrandparent (YC S16) is hiring a Senior Backend Engineer (Node.js/TypeScript)
summary: GoGoGrandparent, a Y Combinator-backed concierge service for seniors, is hiring a Senior Backend Engineer with 6+ years of experience in Node.js and TypeScript. The role is fully remote, offers a salary range of $80K–$180K, and focuses on building scalable backend systems to support services like rides, meals, and medication delivery for older adults. The company is profitable, remote-first, and emphasizes meaningful work with real-world impact on seniors' independence.
key_points: Role: Senior Backend Engineer (Node.js/TypeScript) at GoGoGrandparent, a Y Combinator startup (S16).
Mission: Help older adults live independently by tailoring on-demand services (rides, meals, meds) via phone-based concierge.
Responsibilities: Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend systems; collaborate with product teams; own features end-to-end; troubleshoot production issues; mentor engineers.
Tech Stack: Node.js, TypeScript, MySQL, REST/GraphQL, AWS, Docker/Kubernetes (nice-to-have).
Requirements: 6+ years of experience, US timezone overlap, ownership mindset, and ability to work remotely.
Benefits: Fully remote, $80K–$180K salary, quarterly bonuses, 15 PTO days, healthcare (US), 401k, engineering retreats, and learning budget.
Impact: Work on AI-driven solutions (e.g., conversational phone agents) and high-volume systems for seniors with mobility/cognitive impairments.
Company: Profitable since 2016, 50-person team, no VC funding, co-founded by Justin and David Boogaard/Lung.
